verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance embeds agentic AI across the platform, and several built-in agents take delegated work. The SRE Agent diagnoses and remediates incidents and can be extended with Skills, GitHub and Sentry. The Scribe Agent transcribes calls and records action items. The Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes without manual intervention, and the Insights Agent offers on-demand conversational analytics. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works well in practice, and detail on how users hand ad-hoc tasks to the agents (the evidence consists of short first-party snippets).
